title: The help message is not reproduced verbatim
body_md: If Pro-finder receives a message with invalid content from a destination number, it replies with a message listing possible valid commands. The wording of that reply and the commands it names are not reproduced here. Which commands the device actually accepts is an open, safety-critical item.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Help SMS”
prev_context: Before this stands the position message for smartphones.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 20: the explanation is equivalent in substance, but the commands listed differ between the language versions. This again documents that the command list reads differently per version; the omission follows BLK-005.
